scope: post-hoc diagnostic; official mask not used by inference
L_definition: area-weighted mean E within official edit mask minus area-weighted mean E outside it; not a pre-existing benchmark metric
mask: data/<case>/outer.png; grayscale 0..255 converted to [0,1], PIL BOX area downsample to 64x64; mask 1 = edit region
shift: E_shifted is toroidal 32,32 roll of native E; for GLOBAL E_original is diagnostic of the probe, not an applied global allocation
R85_anchor: raw float tensor was not archived; marked missing rather than substituting a new run or JPEG
denominators: inside and outside weighted cell mass; empty region or missing tensor yields missing L
